subject: reasoning
question:
Two different position of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '4'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e16bc9388b9811e7315a2be79cab010294c37ad9657fd0156e5088810256a627.png]
solution:
Here, we have two dices given and having two faces common.

So, we have:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efd3e139f35f38285ecabb2de4b4b4f622b3aa17b9b50347b956f178c1a8d17c.png] 

So, we will rotate the 2nd dice in such a way that, we get the same positions of common faces as in 1st dice.

Thus, face 1 is opposite to face 4.

Hence, the number '__**1**__' will be on the face opposite to the one showing '4'.
